description: This Java class is a Data Access Object (DAO) implementation for managing DigitalProduct entities. It provides methods to retrieve DigitalProduct instances by associated Product and MerchantStore, or by ID, using QueryDSL and JPA.

classes.name: DigitalProductDaoImpl
classes.description: A DAO implementation class for DigitalProduct that extends generic DAO support and uses QueryDSL for complex queries.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a DigitalProduct based on the provided MerchantStore and Product, ensuring a single result or null.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a DigitalProduct by its unique ID.
